text: Android: a refused expense write is silent — a count in the status bar, no row, no reason
relates: T-203 (the Android counterpart of expense.error.frozen belongs to whichever lands first)

Fixed in 0939216: the refusal is stored on the quarantined row (items.syncBlockedCode / syncBlockedAccountId, Room schema 8, MIGRATION_7_8, exported 8.json), written by SyncEngine and cleared with the quarantine everywhere via ItemEntity.unblocked(); ErrorText.refusal(code, who) maps participant_frozen to expense_error_frozen with the person named as the screen names them, other codes to the error table. The expense list marks the row (warning icon + reason under the row) and the form shows a banner; new string pair expense.notSaved / expense_not_saved "Not saved to the list" in all nine locales on both clients. Tests: SyncEngineTest, ItemsRepoTest, migration 7->8, four ExpenseClosingTest screen tests; each fails with the change mutated out. Shopping-list rows still have no marker: T-210.
